description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at 10⁰, 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 65, with tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, and 65.  A black line with circular markers, representing “Base”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 41%) and ends at approximately (10³, 44%), showing a slight increase. A light brown line with diamond markers, representing “MEND”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 44%) and ends at approximately (10³, 61%), showing a general increase. A blue line with triangular markers, representing “FT”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 43%) and ends at approximately (10³, 47%), showing a slight increase. A red line with triangular markers, representing “IKE”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 44%) and ends at approximately (10³, 53%), showing a general increase. A green line with square markers, representing “MEMIT”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 51%) and ends at approximately (10³, 63%), showing a general increase.
